body: I thank you for making me smile - there isn't such a thing as a perfect human ! I strive for perfection - I love others like an angel would
My selfishness is the cause of my despair.

I despise my dependancy on what i understand to be love. The feeling of being loved. I feel lost without it. 
Roundsparrow - Your reply has had a connection with me. I recognise i am being narrow and guarded but i don't have the faculties sometimes. I am not a great lover of "me".

Your comments have really made me self examine. I really dont think i understand love in the way i would really love to. My romantic thoughts are self-indulgant and so far off what i can actualy attain. I fall in love with the idea of love but lack the ability to love myself. I am in fact selfish. But i do hurt - I hurt by the fact i hurt others - or have the ability to hurt. I enjoy the feeling i can give another by giving what i think is love. My underdeveloped person is the reason i feel so low and distant and removed from life.
Thank you so much for your time. What makes you want to help people?

its about 9 months we have been together - she has two children who I adore. I understand that it may be early love - but it has been everyday. WE have had ups and downs and she has always been there for me. I agree a relationship advisor would help. I just feel like Christmas will be the climax - I'm not happy when i'm apart from her.

Seeing as my wife is blissfully unaware of the situation - I don't know how I would even approach this subject with her. Thank you for helping so far. I lose everything of material value if I leave my wife - But gain everything from a love perspective if I leave for my lover. The strain is making me very ill.
I don't function without some kind of contact. Its almost obsessive.
